missions.title: A delivery to Richmond
missions.brief: Your cargo begins at the mouth of the James. Follow the river inland to Richmond, then carry it around the rapids into the Piedmont.
missions.discovery: At Richmond, the Fall Line interrupts river travel. Moving goods between boats and land helped make this a trading center.

missions.title: Down the York to the bay
missions.brief: Launch at West Point, where the York begins. Navigate southeast past Yorktown to the Chesapeake Bay. Use the compass and the river bends.
missions.discovery: Yorktown is on the York River. The river connects this community to the Chesapeake Bay and wider water routes.

missions.title: Find Fredericksburg
missions.brief: Start at the bay and follow the Rappahannock inland. Deliver your cargo to Fredericksburg. Avoid jumping across the peninsulas.
missions.discovery: Fredericksburg lies on the Rappahannock at the Fall Line. Rivers offered routes inland, but rapids limited boat travel.

missions.title: Alexandria’s water road
missions.brief: Leave Alexandria and follow the Potomac downstream to the Chesapeake Bay. Notice how far north this river is compared with the James.
missions.discovery: Alexandria is on the Potomac, the northernmost of these four rivers. All four connect to the Chesapeake Bay.
